title: REAL Loss: Optimizing Real Expected Acceptance Length for Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.14399v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by having a draft model propose multiple tokens for the target model to verify in one pass. The speedup is governed by the expected acceptance length (EAL), yet standard training objectives such as cross-entropy, KL divergence, and total variation focus only on distribution matching or single-step overlap. Recent studies instead propose block-level training objectives, aiming to optimize EAL directly. However, these objectives remain surrogates rather than exact formulations of EAL. For example, some average later acceptance over target-distributed continuations rather than the verification branches selected by accepted tokens, introducing a covariance gap that can reverse the gradient direction. We analyze this gap and derive REAL, a real EAL training loss that uses path weights for unbiased estimation and Rao-Blackwellization for variance reduction. In a controlled loss-level comparison

translated_title: REAL 损失：为投机解码优化真实期望接受长度
translated_abstract: 投机解码通过让草稿模型提出多个 token，再由目标模型一次性进行验证，从而加速大语言模型（LLM）的推理。加速效果由期望接受长度（EAL）决定，然而交叉熵、KL 散度和总变差等标准训练目标仅关注分布匹配或单步重叠。近期研究转而提出块级训练目标，旨在直接优化 EAL。然而，这些目标仍然是替代目标，而非 EAL 的精确表述。例如，一些方法在目标分布的续写上对后续接受进行平均，而非在被接受 token 所选择的验证分支上进行平均，由此引入了协方差差距，可能导致梯度方向反转。我们分析了这一差距，并推导出 REAL——一种真实的 EAL 训练损失，它使用路径权重实现无偏估计，并利用 Rao-Blackwellization 进行方差缩减。在受控的损失级比较中
tldr: 该论文提出 REAL 损失，通过路径权重无偏估计与 Rao-Blackwellization 方差缩减，直接优化投机解码中真实的期望接受长度（EAL），解决了现有替代目标存在的协方差差距及其梯度方向反转问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes REAL loss, a training objective that directly optimizes the real Expected Acceptance Length (EAL) for speculative decoding using path weights for unbiased estimation and Rao-Blackwellization for variance reduction, addressing the covariance gap that can reverse gradient directions in existing surrogate objectives.
